attributes.description: SRE dashboard for OVH IAM logs. Covers user and API token KPIs, status distributions, role breakdowns, password hygiene, and token activity over time.

embeddableConfig.content:
## OVH IAM — Identity & Access Management
Monitors **users** (`ovh_iam.user`) and **API tokens** (`ovh_iam.token`) collected from the OVH cloud provider. Use the controls above to filter by user status, group, or dataset.

query.esql:
FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE event.category == "iam"
| STATS `Total IAM Records` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE event.category == "iam"
| STATS `Total IAM Records` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.user"
| STATS `Distinct IAM Users` = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.name)

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.user"
| STATS `Distinct IAM Users` = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.name)

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.token"
| STATS `Total number of API tokens` = COUNT()

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.token"
| STATS `Total number of API tokens` = COUNT()

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.token"
| STATS `Count of distinct token names` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ovh.iam.token.name)

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.token"
| STATS `Count of distinct token names` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ovh.iam.token.name)

FROM logs-ovh_*
| STATS `Event Count` = COUNT() BY `@timestamp` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Dataset` = data_stream.dataset
| SORT `@timestamp`

FROM logs-ovh_*
| STATS `Event Count` = COUNT() BY `@timestamp` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Dataset` = data_stream.dataset
| SORT `@timestamp`

query.esql:
FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.user"
| STATS `User Count` = COUNT(*) BY `Status` = ovh.iam.user.status
| SORT `User Count` DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.user"
| STATS `User Count` = COUNT(*) BY `Status` = ovh.iam.user.status
| SORT `User Count` DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.user"
| STATS `User Count` = COUNT(*) BY `Group` = `ovh.iam.user.group`
| SORT `User Count` DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.user"
| STATS `User Count` = COUNT(*) BY `Group` = `ovh.iam.user.group`
| SORT `User Count` DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.user"
| STATS `Count` = COUNT(*) BY `User Type` = ovh.iam.user.type
| SORT `Count` DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.user"
| STATS `Count` = COUNT(*) BY `User Type` = ovh.iam.user.type
| SORT `Count` DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.user" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `User Count` = COUNT() BY user.roles
| SORT `User Count` DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.user" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `User Count` = COUNT() BY user.roles
| SORT `User Count` DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.user"
| STATS `Email` = VALUES(user.email), `Status` = VALUES(ovh.iam.user.status), `Group` = VALUES(`ovh.iam.user.group`), `Type` = VALUES(ovh.iam.user.type), `Password Last Update` = VALUES(ovh.iam.user.password_last_update), `Latest Timestamp` = MAX(@timestamp) BY `Name` = user.name
| KEEP `Name`, `Email`, `Status`, `Group`, `Type`, `Password Last Update`
| LIMIT 100

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.user"
| STATS `Email` = VALUES(user.email), `Status` = VALUES(ovh.iam.user.status), `Group` = VALUES(`ovh.iam.user.group`), `Type` = VALUES(ovh.iam.user.type), `Password Last Update` = VALUES(ovh.iam.user.password_last_update), `Latest Timestamp` = MAX(@timestamp) BY `Name` = user.name
| KEEP `Name`, `Email`, `Status`, `Group`, `Type`, `Password Last Update`
| LIMIT 100

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.token" AND ovh.iam.token.last_used IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Count of tokens used` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.token" AND ovh.iam.token.last_used IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Count of tokens used` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.token" AND DATE_EXTRACT("year", ovh.iam.token.expires_at) >= 2106
| STATS `Count of Non-Expiring Tokens` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.token" AND DATE_EXTRACT("year", ovh.iam.token.expires_at) >= 2106
| STATS `Count of Non-Expiring Tokens` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.token" AND ovh.iam.token.last_used >= ?_tstart AND ovh.iam.token.last_used < ?_tend
| STATS `Token Activity Count` = COUNT(*) BY `Time Bucket` = BUCKET(ovh.iam.token.last_used, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Token Name` = ovh.iam.token.name
| SORT `Time Bucket`, `Token Activity Count` DESC

FROM logs-ovh_*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "ovh_iam.token" AND ovh.iam.token.last_used >= ?_tstart AND ovh.iam.token.last_used < ?_tend
| STATS `Token Activity Count` = COUNT(*) BY `Time Bucket` = BUCKET(ovh.iam.token.last_used, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Token Name` = ovh.iam.token.name
| SORT `Time Bucket`, `Token Activity Count` DESC
